topic: Returning an Item Without a Receipt

script.title: NO RECEIPT, NO PROBLEM?
script.story_hook: A gift comes back without the receipt.
script.intro_zh: 收來的禮物，手上卻沒有收據。
script.welcome_en: Welcome back, good to see you! Today we return a gift with no receipt.
script.welcome_zh: 歡迎回來，很高興見到你！今天要退貨，卻沒有收據。
script.outro: That's one tricky return done right. Keep listening!
script.outro_zh: 一次高難度的退貨圓滿完成啦。繼續多聽！
script.practice_intro_en: Now repeat after me, one line at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 現在跟著我，一行一行重複。
script.char_a_description: a petite woman in her early thirties with long straight black hair in a low ponytail, wearing a mustard corduroy jacket and white sneakers, hugging a gift bag
script.char_b_description: a heavyset man in his forties with thinning gray hair and wire-rim glasses, wearing a beige polo with a returns badge, spinning a pen between his fingers
script.youtube_title: 【🧾無收據退貨英文】🔄吊牌寫「不退不換」怎麼辦🤔身分證查詢逆轉全場｜Store Return Without Receipt
script.youtube_title_en: “Final Sale?” — Returning an Item Without a Receipt
script.youtube_description:
禮物不合用，收據卻找不到？這段超真實的退貨對話教你冷靜過關！在賣場服務台，跟著 Anna 用身分證查出購買紀錄、面對「不退不換」吊牌、拿到店內購物金。整段 18 句美式日常英語，附上繁體中文翻譯與 IPA 標音，後半段逐句跟讀，聽一遍就會開口用。

script.youtube_description_en:
The gift doesn't fit and the receipt is gone? This real returns-desk dialogue keeps you calm under pressure. Follow Anna through the ID lookup, a scary final sale tag, and a happy store credit ending — 18 lines of everyday American English with IPA, plus line-by-line repeat practice in the second half.
#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish
Subscribe for a new episode every day!
script.youtube_title_ref: 【🎬沉浸式英文動畫】🧾退貨英文｜身分證查紀錄・面對不退不換・拿到購物金｜聽完就會用｜🌱A2 初級英文｜💡不用背，多聽就會用｜🎧聽力口說練習｜後段逐句跟讀
script.youtube_description_ref:
📌 影片簡介：
禮物是表姐送的，收據早不知去向？
吊牌寫著「不退不換」，還能想辦法嗎？

這一集帶大家走進賣場退貨服務台，Anna 拿著一台烤得太焦的麵包機，從身分證查購買紀錄、聽店員談退換規定，到最後收進店內購物金，全程都是自然的美式口語。

你會聽到：
🧾 開口退貨：例如「I'd like to return this bread maker」。
🪪 查購買紀錄：例如「we can look it up by ID」、「found it, bought nine days ago」。
🔄 退換規定與結尾：例如「refund, exchange, or store credit」、「this tag says final sale」。

後半段是逐句聽力加上跟讀練習 🎧，先聽一遍，再跟著一句一句唸，把整段對話變成自然的口語直覺。

🌱 適合 A2 初級英文學習者：不用死背，跟著情境反覆聽，自然就會用。

下次退貨別再心虛，一句「look it up by ID」就能翻盤！
script.thumbnail_action: handing over a bread maker box

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'd like to return this bread maker.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪd laɪk tʊ rɪˈtɜːrn ðɪs brɛd ˌmeɪkər/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure. Do you have the receipt with you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr du ju hæv ðə rɪˈsiːt wɪð juː/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Um, honestly no. My cousin gifted it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌm ˈɑːnəstli noʊ maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈɡɪftɪd ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 呃，實話說沒有，這是表姐送的禮物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No worries, we can look it up by ID.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ ˈwɜːriz wi kæn lʊk ɪt ʌp baɪ ˌaɪˈdiː/
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我們可以用身分證查詢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, here's my license. I'll wait, no rush.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt hɪrz maɪ ˈlaɪsəns aɪl weɪt noʊ rʌʃ/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，這是我的身分證，我不趕時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, bought nine days ago, right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt bɔːt naɪn deɪz əˈɡoʊ raɪt hɪr/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，九天就在我們這裡買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wow, that works? Technology these days, huh.
dialogue.phonetic: /waʊ ðæt wɜːrks tɛkˈnɑːlədʒi ðiːz deɪz hʌh/
dialogue.zh: 哇，這樣也行？現在的科技真厲害。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yep. So what went wrong with it?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛp soʊ wʌt wɛnt rɔːŋ wɪð ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 對啊，所以它是哪裡出了狀況？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It toasts the bread way too dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈtoʊsts ðə brɛd weɪ tuː dɑːrk/
dialogue.zh: 烤麵包烤得太焦，皮黑得誇張。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Got it. Refund, exchange, or store credit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑːt ɪt ˈriːfʌnd ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ər stɔːr ˈkrɛdɪt/
dialogue.zh: 了解。要退款、換貨，還是店內購物金？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Store credit please, I'm just returning a gift.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɔːr ˈkrɛdɪt pliːz aɪm dʒʌst rɪˈtɜːrnɪŋ ə ɡɪft/
dialogue.zh: 購物金就好，反正禮物不是我買的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect. One snag though — this tag says final sale.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜːrfɪkt wʌn snæɡ ðoʊ ðɪs tæɡ sɛz ˈfaɪnəl seɪl/
dialogue.zh: 好。不過有個小狀況，這吊牌寫著不退不換。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, does that ruin the whole plan?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ dʌz ðæt ˈruːɪn ðə hoʊl plæn/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，那我的盤算全泡湯了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Usually yes, but this tag's half torn off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈjuːʒuəli jɛs bʌt ðɪs tæɡz hæf tɔːrn ɔːf/
dialogue.zh: 通常是，不過這標籤已經裂了一半。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So... maybe luck is on my side today?
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈmeɪbi lʌk ɪz ɑːn maɪ saɪd təˈdeɪ/
dialogue.zh: 所以……今天運氣站在我這邊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, today yes. I'll let it slide, friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ təˈdeɪ jɛs aɪl lɛt ɪt slaɪd frɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 哈哈，今天是。這次就讓我通融一下吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You're a star! Thanks for all your help.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊrz ə stɑːr θæŋks fɔːr ɔːl jɔːr hɛlp/
dialogue.zh: 你真是大明星！謝謝你所有的幫忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Anytime! Have a great rest of your day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛniˌtaɪm hæv ə ɡreɪt rɛst əv jɔːr deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 不客氣！歡迎隨時再來，祝你今天愉快。
